newsitem.title: UK: HSBC, Standard Chartered off as Hang Seng falls.
newsitem.headline: HSBC, Standard Chartered off as Hang Seng falls.

text.p: Shares in HSBC Holdings and Standard Chartered fell on Tuesday, weighed by losses in Hong Kong and amid negative broker comment, dealers said.
Shares in HSBC fell 13p to 11.50 stg by 0953 GMT after the stock shed HK$1.5 to HK$134.5 in Hong Kong.
The Hang Seng lost 85 points or 0.75 percent on Tuesday amid growing fears over an imminent interest rate hike there.
Shares in Standard Chartered, a London-based Asian specialist bank, were 9p lower at 710p.

Analysts at HSBC James Capel repeated their "hold' stance on the stock today in a sector note after their results three weeks ago, " a source at the broker said. "We reiterated this in a note on the sector today."
